description: This file defines the Location class and related functions for managing geographic location data, including area calculations, feature management, and database interactions within a Frappe framework application.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: A class representing a geographic location with nested set hierarchy, capable of calculating area, managing features, and updating ancestor/descendant location data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the location object, calculating area and updating ancestor features if necessary.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the location is updated, delegating to NestedSet's on_update.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the location is deleted, including validation and ancestor feature removal.

methods.name: calculate_location_area
methods.description: Calculates the geographic area of the location based on its features.

methods.name: get_location_features
methods.description: Retrieves the GeoJSON features associated with the location.

methods.name: set_location_features
methods.description: Sets the GeoJSON features for the location and updates the database.

methods.name: update_ancestor_location_features
methods.description: Updates features and area of ancestor locations based on current location's features.

methods.name: remove_ancestor_location_features
methods.description: Removes current location's features from ancestor locations.

methods.name: add_child_property
methods.description: Adds 'child_feature' property to features that are children of this location.

methods.name: feature_seperator
methods.description: Separates features into child features and non-child features based on 'feature_of' property.
